stop.start_time_proof_limit: Raw owned-stop.txt field start_ticks used whitespace-delimited stat field 22 and is not accepted as a reliable process start timestamp.

builtin_winhttp_startup_comparison.interpretation: One base-client startup survived 85 seconds while the preceding instrumented startup failed after 17 seconds. This implicates the injected startup path or a timing interaction; it does not prove a particular plugin defect. This is not contact or normal-runtime stability evidence.

stop.proc_stat_parser: Fields after the closing comm parenthesis; index 19 is process start time

core_only_copy_startup_comparison.interpretation: BepInEx core completed startup in this fresh copy without runtime plugins. This does not isolate a particular plugin or exclude timing/cache/path effects, and is not a contact measurement.

two_required_plugins_eager_preload.last_recorded_stage: Interop preload warning before plugin-count or Loading messages

two_required_plugins_lazy_preload.interpretation: The lazy-load startup passed the previously failing stage. This supports a workaround involving eager preload, without proving a race, permanent stability or simulator parity. Subsequent live collection is recorded separately.
